page.overview:
Who is Cap'n?

Prior to the events of the Oracle games, Queen Ambi fell in love with a sea-faring man, the Cap'n, who was the leader of a band of pirates.

In a Linked , the storyline brought up but never completed in of Queen Ambi's long lost lover is concluded. After clearing the , Queen Ambi will be at the Samasa Desert entrance, sent there by Nayru at the queen's request. Ambi ends up meeting up again with the Cap'n, and although he says he wished he could stay, Ambi interrupts him and tells him she understands why he must leave her side again: he is a seafaring man and cannot live his life on land. Before departing ways again, Ambi promises the Cap'n that she will always be waiting for his return.

In , the shipwrecks in Samasa Desert, plunging the crew into Subrosia. Stranded, the Cap'n and his crew take up residence in the House of Pirates. During the shipwreck, the Cap'n loses his bell. He sends some members of his crew to search for it, refusing to leave until it is found. Once Link completes the , the Cap'n deems the young hero to be a competent adventurer and asks him to help search for the bell. Once Link finds and fixes the bell, the Cap'n orders the crew to set sail, However, they are soon overcome with seasickness, having been on land for so long. He orders the crew to dock the ship in a bay on the Western Coast. Link can use the ship as a bridge to the Graveyard and Explorer's Crypt.

In , the Cap'n appears trapped in a large ring of whirlpools within the Sea of Storms in the past, accessible after the seventh dungeon. The Cap'n is able to escape the sea once Link gives him the Zora Scale he obtained recently, which is a powerful charm capable of calming the seas. The Cap'n declares he and his crew are off to Holodrum. Before leaving, he gives Link the Tokay Eyeball as a sign of his thanks. In a Linked Game coming over from Oracle of Seasons, Cap'n and his crew end up trapped in the Sea of Storms in the present rather than the past after they were able to set sail from Holodrum after overcoming their seasickness. When Link arrives aboard their ship and shows them the Zora Scale, grateful to Link for helping them out again, Cap'n hands him the Tokay Eyeball before he and his crew make their escape from the Sea of Storms to resume their seafaring adventures.
